title: Organization plan
description: Review and manage the billing plan and effective entitlements of this organization.
loadingPlanDescription: Fetching the assignment and effective entitlements.

summary.noLimitsAssigned: This plan defines no quantitative limits. The catalog defaults remain in effect.
summary.noLimitsUnassigned: No plan is assigned, so no quantitative limits apply. Assign a plan to define entitlements.

history.title: Plan change history
history.empty: No plan change history is available.

plan.noAccessTitle: No access to the organization plan

plans.errorTitle: Could not load the active plans
